seed: A snap that is showing is a snap you get. Every drag here is walked with a shaking hand (wobble) across a line something can catch on, and every drag line in the log says how many times the guides came and went. One catch and one let go across a pass is the whole point; more than that is the flicker this walk exists to measure.

steps.note: the box everything below lines itself up with: its left edge is at 500
the box about to be resized, selected
right edge walked up to 480, still clear of the peer's 500
a shaking hand walking the right edge from 480 to 530, straight through the peer's left edge at 500. Expect the drag line to say caught 1, let go 1.
walked back to 497, three short of the peer edge: expect the edge exactly on 500 with a guide showing
Command held the whole way: expect no guide at all and the edge exactly where the pointer left it
the whole box walked up the canvas with a shaking hand, across the canvas middle at 350: expect it caught once and still held at the end, so the box centres on 350
